chunks: Abu Maʿmar narrated to us; he said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the Imam being washed by the Imam. He said: “It is the sunnah (tradition) of Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the divinely appointed Imam in Shia doctrine
key_terms.سُنَّةُ: an established divinely sanctioned tradition or precedent
key_terms.عِمْرَانَ: ʿImrān, the father of Mūsā عليه السلام
key_terms.يَغْسِلُهُ: performs the ritual washing of his body after death

ai.seo_question: Who washes an Imam after his death according to this hadith from al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the funeral washing of an Imam is carried out by another Imam. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام describes this as the sunnah of Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام, indicating a divinely established pattern connected to prophetic tradition and the special station of the Imam.
